catalogRecords.name: DSH Bridge
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Provides local session messaging and event bridging between DeepSeek Harness nodes.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 节点提供本地会话消息与事件桥接。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the matching npm release and package manifest declare MIT but the fixed repository has no license file; no bridge behavior ran.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：npm 发布物与包清单声明 MIT，但固定源码仓库缺少许可证文件；未运行桥接行为。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Weave
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Connects DeepSeek Harness nodes through a private peer-to-peer weave protocol.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过私有点对点 weave 协议连接多个 DeepSeek Harness 节点。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses, matching npm gitHead and install identity were reviewed statically; networking and storage were not executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证、匹配的 npm gitHead 与安装身份；未执行网络或存储行为。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Monitor
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Shows session costs and configurable provider usage or quota data in the DSH web interface.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 在 DSH Web 界面展示会话费用及可配置的提供方用量或配额数据。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The documented Git install tag resolves to the fixed commit and licenses and bundle structure are present; provider requests, credentials and UI code were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 文档中的 Git 安装标签指向固定提交，许可证与 bundle 结构完整；未执行提供方请求、凭据访问或 UI 代码。

catalogRecords.name: DSH 1024 Store
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Combines an in-app plugin catalog with a tracked wrapper around the official DSH plugin command.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 将产品内插件目录与官方 DSH 插件命令的安装统计包装器结合。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because documentation installs dsh1024 from npm but version 0.4.0 is unavailable in the registry; no installer, telemetry, prepack or plugin operation ran.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：文档要求从 npm 安装 dsh1024，但注册表中无 0.4.0；未运行安装器、遥测、prepack 或插件操作。

catalogRecords.name: DSH System Restart
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds a sidebar control that requests a DeepSeek Harness web-process restart.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 在侧边栏加入请求重启 DeepSeek Harness Web 进程的控件。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the fixed repository has no license file; the unpublished local-source install and process-control implementation were not executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：固定源码仓库缺少许可证文件；未执行未发布的本地源码安装或进程控制实现。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Studio
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds wallpaper controls and an agent collaboration board to an integrated DSH desktop workspace.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为集成式 DSH 桌面工作区加入壁纸控制与智能体协作看板。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the nested bundle is installed only by the enclosing desktop setup and has no independent npm or Git-source install identity; setup and desktop code were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：嵌套 bundle 仅由外层桌面安装流程装入，缺少独立 npm 或 Git 源安装身份；未运行 setup 或桌面代码。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Chat Rail
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds a scroll-aware right-side message navigation rail to DSH conversations.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为 DSH 会话加入感知滚动位置的右侧消息导航画卷。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses, exact npm gitHead and documented install identity were reviewed statically; conversation UI behavior was not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证、精确 npm gitHead 与文档安装身份；未运行会话 UI 行为。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Paper Daily
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Collects daily condensed-matter papers from arXiv and selected APS journals with optional summaries.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 从 arXiv 与选定 APS 期刊收集每日凝聚态论文，并可生成摘要。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, licenses, native bundle structure and GitHub-source install identity were reviewed statically; feeds, summaries, credentials and UI were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、许可证、原生 bundle 结构与 GitHub 源安装身份；未运行论文源、摘要、凭据或 UI。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Simplified Chinese UI
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Localizes DSH browser interface text into Simplified Chinese through client-side data and DOM translation.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过客户端数据层与 DOM 文本翻译将 DSH 浏览器界面汉化为简体中文。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses and documented Git clone installation identity were reviewed statically; browser translation code was not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证与文档 Git 克隆安装身份；未运行浏览器汉化代码。

catalogRecords.name: DSH LAN Access
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Toggles the DSH web server between loopback-only and local-network binding.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 在仅回环与局域网监听之间切换 DSH Web 服务器绑定地址。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the package is unpublished and documented Git install examples retain owner and repository placeholders; network exposure, credentials and dynamic patch behavior were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：包未发布且文档 Git 安装示例仍保留 owner 与 repository 占位符；未执行网络暴露、凭据或动态 patch 行为。

catalogRecords.name: Frieren DSH Theme
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Applies a Frieren-inspired parchment, gold, magic-circle and petal theme to the DSH web interface.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为 DSH Web 界面应用芙莉莲主题的羊皮纸、金色、魔法阵与花瓣视觉。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses and repository-specific Git install identity were reviewed statically; assets, animation and client injection were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证与仓库专属 Git 安装身份；未运行动画、素材或客户端注入。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Dock
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds a persistent usage dock with provider balances and guarded restart or stop controls.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 加入常驻用量面板、提供方余额以及受保护的重启或停止控件。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, package license file, bundle structure and monorepo Git-path install identity were reviewed statically; provider requests and process controls were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、包许可证文件、bundle 结构与 monorepo Git 路径安装身份；未执行提供方请求或进程控制。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Fold
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Folds conversation turns and tool rows in the DSH web interface to reduce visual noise.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 折叠 DSH Web 界面的会话轮次与工具行以减少视觉噪声。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses and GitHub-source install identity were reviewed statically; custom install scripts, tests and browser UI were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证与 GitHub 源安装身份；未运行自定义安装脚本、测试或浏览器 UI。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Wallpaper Share
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Synchronizes and shares wallpaper state through a DSH host and browser client bundle.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过 DSH 宿主与浏览器客户端 bundle 同步和共享壁纸状态。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses and GitHub-source install identity were reviewed statically; polling, routes, storage and client behavior were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证与 GitHub 源安装身份；未执行轮询、路由、存储或客户端行为。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Vision Bridge
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Routes image requests through local OCR, cached evidence and configurable remote vision providers.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过本地 OCR、缓存证据和可配置远程视觉提供方路由图像请求。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed monorepo source, nested license, patch and documented file-source identity were reviewed statically; postinstall, native OCR helper, providers, tests and plugins were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定 monorepo 源码、嵌套许可证、patch 与文档 file 源身份；未运行 postinstall、原生 OCR helper、提供方、测试或插件。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Web UI Launcher
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Provides model tools, commands and a settings card for starting, stopping and opening the DSH web interface.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 提供用于启动、停止和打开 DSH Web 界面的模型工具、命令与设置卡片。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses, compatibility ranges and GitHub-source install identity were reviewed statically; launchers, processes, tools, servers and browser code were not run.

catalogRecords.name: DSH Plugin Toggle
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds persistent enable and disable controls for installed DSH plugins in Settings.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 在设置页为已安装 DSH 插件加入可持久化的启用与停用控件。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source, patch, licenses and repository-specific Git install identities were reviewed statically; plugin stop-start operations, persistence and UI were not run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已静态核对固定源码、patch、许可证与仓库专属 Git 安装身份；未执行插件启停、持久化或 UI。
